name: instruction-md
description: Your agent follows its instructions from instruction.md: the version a project follows (.instruction/follow.json) at each session's start, and a new one at the next prompt once it is released, its signature checked.

interface.shortDescription: Follow your instructions from instruction.md, kept current
interface.longDescription: A project names the instruction it follows in .instruction/follow.json. Codex gets its text when a session starts and the new text at the next prompt after a release, checked against the publisher's signature. The instruction.md MCP server serves it as the resource instruction://current.
defaultPrompt: Show me the instructions this project follows.
Which version of our instructions am I working with?
